title: Job Worker Module Compiler
description: Compiles a BullMQ/Bull job worker. Enforces: job payload validated on receipt, idempotency key checked before processing, typed error handling (non-retryable vs retryable), worker concurrency from spec, no uncaught promise rejections in processor.

error_codes.JW002: job-producer-artifact.json not found — compile job-producer first
error_codes.JW003: Job payload not validated on receipt before processing
error_codes.JW004: No idempotency key check before processing (missing deduplication)
error_codes.JW005: Error not classified as retryable vs non-retryable (UnrecoverableError missing)
error_codes.JW006: Promise rejection not caught in processor function
